subject: Media Literacy
title: Books as Revolutionary Tools
description: Learn Books as Revolutionary Tools in one minute.

hook.text: Uncle Tom's Cabin sold 300,000 copies in its first year and fueled the movement to end slavery.

buildup.text: Throughout history, books have started revolutions, toppled regimes, and reshaped cultures.

discovery.text: Thomas Paine's Common Sense convinced American colonists that independence was possible.

twist.text: Authoritarian regimes know this. That's why book banning and book burning are as old as books.

climax.text: A book is just paper and ink — yet tyrants fear books more than armies.

punchline.text: The pen has always terrified the sword.

quiz.question: Why do authoritarian regimes ban and burn books?
options: Ideas in books can inspire resistance
Books take up too much space
